scans.title: Suspicious Job Offer (Phishing) [Sample Demonstration]
scans.summary: This message shows multiple signs of a phishing attempt, using deceptive recruitment tactics and urgent language.

keyFindings.title: Urgency and pressure tactics
keyFindings.description: The message uses urgent language ("urgent action required", "offer expires in 2 hours") to create psychological pressure.

keyFindings.title: Suspicious sender domain
keyFindings.description: Sender domain (career-update.com) mimics legitimate portals but was registered 4 days ago with privacy guards.

keyFindings.title: Request for upfront payment
keyFindings.description: Asks for an onboarding verification registration fee before the employment contract is signed.

safetyActions: Do not transfer money or share bank account/UPI details.
Verify the employer by visiting their official verified company domain directly.
Never provide OTPs, passwords, or government identity cards via messaging apps.
Report the sender number to the National Cyber Crime Reporting Portal (1930 / cybercrime.gov.in).

findings.title: SSL Certificate Expiring Soon
findings.description: TLS certificate expires in 12 days. Auto-renewal has failed.
findings.impact: Loss of HTTPS encryption, browser red warning screens, customer transaction drop-off.
findings.remediation: Renew certificate using Certbot or host management console before expiry.

findings.title: Missing Security Headers
findings.description: HTTP Strict Transport Security (HSTS) and Content-Security-Policy (CSP) headers are not enabled.
findings.impact: Susceptible to SSL-stripping and cross-site scripting (XSS) injection attacks.
findings.remediation: Configure Strict-Transport-Security: max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains and CSP in web server.

findings.title: Outdated Software
findings.description: WordPress 6.1 detected (latest stable: 6.5.x). 3 known CVE vulnerabilities present in core.
findings.impact: Known automated vulnerability exploits against unpatched CMS installations.
findings.remediation: Create staging backup and apply security patch upgrade to WordPress latest stable branch.

remediationTasks.title: Enable MFA on important accounts
remediationTasks.description: Protects against account takeovers and password stuffing by requiring hardware or app-based 2FA.

remediationTasks.title: Update website SSL certificate
remediationTasks.description: Prevents data interception and eliminates browser security warnings for visitors on example-business.com.

remediationTasks.title: Review staff access permissions
remediationTasks.description: Reduces insider and external risks by revoking stale contractor tokens and enforcing least privilege.

remediationTasks.title: Patch WordPress to latest release
remediationTasks.description: Upgrade WordPress 6.1 to 6.5.2 to eliminate known CVEs in media handling.

remediationTasks.title: Implement HSTS and Content-Security-Policy
remediationTasks.description: Add HTTP response security headers to eliminate SSL stripping and mitigate XSS.
